name: zentrik
description: Bring your team's product decisions and customer evidence into ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Ground product work in customer evidence
interface.longDescription: Search product context and customer evidence, trace decisions to source records, and capture approved evidence in one authorized Zentrik workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find recent customer evidence about reporting and fetch the most relevant result.
What customer problems repeat across recent evidence, and which opportunities do they support?
Save these customer notes as evidence in Zentrik, then confirm when processing is complete.
